meaningful_v3 refers to incremental broad-screen registry, not the later HierarchicalSourceRoleV3 module.
canonical_family is a navigation/deduplication label, not a verified count of scientifically distinct mechanisms; graph/head topology and approximation details can differ within a family.

mechanism_evidence.equation: For s in1..S,r in1..R: As=softmax(Qs Ks^T/sqrt(d)); Zsr=As Vr. bs,r=softmax_r(dot(Qvalue_s(X),Kvalue(Zsr))/sqrt(d)); Ys=sum_r bs,r*Zsr; Y=concat_s(Ys)Wo.

Output mixture depends on actual candidate retrieval content

methods.mechanism_evidence: Alternating coupling splits condition positive bin widths/heights and positive knot derivatives on unchanged coordinates. Each transformed coordinate uses a monotone rational-quadratic interpolant, with analytic inverse and identity tails. Stacking alternating splits gives an invertible nonlinear multivariate transformation, not a scalar evidence gate.

methods.mechanism_evidence: A weight-tied nonlinear map is evaluated at its fixed point using a root solver without recording all forward iterations. Training solves a transpose-Jacobian linear fixed-point system for the implicit adjoint. The root-and-adjoint pair, rather than the choice of sequence backbone, is the transferred mechanism.

mechanism_evidence.chain: Q/K/V -> pairwise head-score vector -> input-conditioned five-branch Compose -> token softmax -> independently parameterized five-branch Compose -> value aggregation -> output projection.
mechanism_evidence.equation: For a pair's H-vector a, Compose(a,xi,xj)=a Wb+(a Uq(xi))Vq(xi)+a* gq(xi)+(a Uk(xj))Vk(xj)+a*gk(xj). U/V are generated by a GELU MLP, U is RMS-normalized across heads, g=tanh(linear(x)); use independent pre/post sets. A=softmax_keys(Compose_pre(QK^T/sqrt(d))); O=Compose_post(A) V Wo.
must_preserve: Both pre-softmax and post-softmax Compose
Query-wise AND key-wise dynamic off-diagonal head composition
Both diagonal composition terms and base identity
RMS normalization of generated first factors
Separate dynamic generators for pre/post stages

methods.mechanism_evidence: Each dense symmetric layer appends learned nowhere-to-attend vectors to both banks, forms projected head affinities, and obtains the two directions by row/column normalization of the same affinity. Attend original full-width values and average across parallel attention maps, not concatenate projected values. Remove sentinel query rows, then update both original banks simultaneously by x+ReLU(W[x,attended_other]+b). Repeat the full layer with independent parameters. Dense refers to all-pair interactions, not DenseNet concatenation of all earlier layers.

mechanism_evidence.equation: For each differential head, A=softmax(Q1 K1^T/sqrt(d))-lambda*softmax(Q2 K2^T/sqrt(d)); Y=(1-lambda_init)*RMSNorm(A V); concatenate Y and apply Wo. lambda=exp(dot(lambda_q1,lambda_k1))-exp(dot(lambda_q2,lambda_k2))+lambda_init.
must_preserve: Both separate softmax normalizations
Signed subtraction before value aggregation
Learned exponential-difference lambda parameterization
Per-head RMSNorm and fixed scaling
Output projection

mechanism_evidence.equation: sj=softmax((xj Wsymbol) Ftemplates^T/sqrt(ds)) Slibrary. r_ij,l=dot(xi Wq_rel,l,xj Wk_rel,l)/sqrt(dr). a_i,h=sum_j alpha_ij,h*(r_ij Wr,h+sj Ws,h), where alpha has separate attention Q/K. Concatenate sensory heads sum_j beta_ij,h*Vj with the relational heads after each branch's output projection.

methods.mechanism_evidence: Threshold the matrix residual to estimate signed sparse corruption, then update two low-rank factors using their inverse Gram matrices as preconditioners. Both factors use the old factor pair for a simultaneous step. A spectral initializer precedes the finite learned iteration chain. The source also offers recurrent continuation, which is not selected here.

methods.mechanism_evidence: Four-step MAC with separate control and temporary reasoning-memory states. Each control is an attention mixture over conditioning tokens, using step-specific global-query projection plus prior control. The read first combines prior memory with knowledge elements, then scores those interactions using control, and averages knowledge values. The write linearly integrates retrieved information and prior memory. Preserve the mandatory control/read/write chain; optional write self-attention and gate are disabled, as explicitly allowed by the paper.

mechanism_evidence.formula: [X_r^(l+1),Zhat_r^(l+1)]=T_r^l([X_r^l,Z^l]); Z^(l+1)=mean_{r active} Zhat_r^(l+1). All r use the same snapshot Z^l. Later rounds make the aggregate affect the original stream tokens.

Full joint stream-and-bottleneck self-attention and FFN blocks

methods.mechanism_evidence: Complete MCA encoder-decoder: six question-bank SA blocks encode Q; six evidence-bank SGA blocks each self-attend V, cross-attend with Q_final as keys/values, then apply a4d ReLU FFN. Each sublayer has residual/post-LayerNorm. Scaled multihead attention uses sqrt(head_width). Both banks retain their token cardinalities; there is no learned latent bottleneck. mechanism_evidence.chain: Persistent order-2 pair tensor -> two independent shared per-pair nonlinear channel maps -> channelwise matrix multiplication over a third vertex -> concatenate previous pair state -> linear channel compression -> repeat three complete blocks -> diagonal/off-diagonal summaries.
mechanism_evidence.equation: For layer l and channel c, A=f_l(X), B=g_l(X), P[i,j,c]=sum_k A[i,k,c]*B[k,j,c], X_next[i,j,:]=W_l concat(X[i,j,:],P[i,j,:])+b_l. f_l and g_l are separate two-layer ReLU MLPs applied independently at every pair. No attention softmax, row normalization, Hadamard-only replacement or node-only collapse occurs between blocks.
mechanism_evidence.equivariance: Under a simultaneous permutation of pair axes, each channel transforms X_c -> Q X_c Q^T, and its product transforms identically. Endpoint feature lifting and diagonal extraction respect the same relabeling when categorical role/head identities move with the tokens.
must_preserve: A learned feature vector for EVERY active ordered pair throughout all three blocks
Independent left and right nonlinear pair transforms
The sum over intermediate vertex k, with matching channels, not a dot product over features
Concatenation of old pair state before the source linear compression
ReLU after each of the two branch affine layers, but no invented activation after the skip reducer
Separate diagonal and off-diagonal summaries from every block

mechanism_evidence.formula: A=softmax_over_inputs(MLP(LN(X))^T); Z=A X; Z'=Transformer(Z); U=LN(W_token LN(Z')); B=sigmoid(MLP(LN(X))); DeltaX=B U; X'=X+DeltaX. W_token acts on the compressed-token axis, not channels; A and B are not tied/transposes.
must_preserve: Input-dependent compressed token values
A complete self-attention plus FFN residual block in compressed space
Learned mixing among compressed token indices
A separate input-dependent synthesis map to each original token
The original-token residual path

mechanism_evidence.formula: For each source i in A choose j(i)=argmax_{j in B} cos(mean_heads K_i,mean_heads K_j); keep top-r source edges. Merge z_C=sum_{i in C}s_i x_i/sum_{i in C}s_i with s_C=sum_i s_i. Later attention is softmax(QK^T/sqrt(d)+log(s)^T)V. Unmerge copies each merged output to its tracked original members.

Best destination plus global top-r source-edge selection
Size-weighted values and cumulative sizes
At least a second attention block that consumes log sizes
Attention-before-merge-before-FFN placement
Source-membership tracking and restoration to original slots
